activate.description: Bring Brave to the foreground without delivering a URL or changing tabs.

open-url.description: Deliver one explicit HTTP or HTTPS URL through CoreDevice without claiming which Brave tab receives it.

go-back.description: Navigate back once in the visible non-Now task page.

reload-page.description: Verify the shared Stop/Reload control is visibly Reload, then reload the owned non-Now task page once.

show-tabs.description: Open Brave's tab overview without selecting, creating, reordering, grouping, or closing a tab.

foreground-now.description: Foreground Brave without URL delivery so an existing durable Now page can acknowledge first.

open-task-url.description: Open one explicit web destination while preserving the durable Now contract and existing user tabs.

navigate-task-page-back.description: Navigate back once on a visible non-Now page whose history belongs to the current task.

reload-task-page.description: Reload once on a visible non-Now page owned by the current task.

open-tab-overview.description: Open the tab overview without reading or operating tabs.

prohibited: closing, reordering, grouping, or selecting an unowned tab
closing or repurposing the durable Now tab
claiming tab ownership from CoreDevice URL delivery alone
enumerating tab titles, thumbnails, history, bookmarks, downloads, saved passwords, autofill, wallet, or private browsing state
changing Brave, Shields, privacy, search, sync, account, or tab-retention settings
clearing browsing data or private tabs
submitting forms, downloading files, payments, account changes, or protected confirmations
safety.uncertain_outcome: Brave may have loaded the URL, changed history, or changed tab selection before a response was lost. Inspect the visible page without resending or closing anything.

host: Appium/XCUITest only for optional toolbar actions
permissions: locally signed WebDriverAgent only for toolbar actions

data_access: explicit URL supplied by the caller
Now readiness acknowledgement handled by the display page
data_sent: URLs and normal Brave requests to destination hosts
privacy.retention: The integration stores no browser content or tab inventory. Brave may retain history, website data, and tabs under its own settings.
privacy.notes: The addon is disabled unless explicitly enabled. It never exposes close-tab or clear-data actions; task-owned cleanup requires separate evidence of ownership and exact authority.
